# C002 Product Administration Fixtures

`valid-synthetic.yaml` exercises all eight policy record kinds using unmistakable
synthetic candidate records. It is not canonical Product, SKU, Brand, Mass,
Appearance, Availability, Commerce, BOM, import, or runtime data.

`mutation-cases.json` is the counted negative/adversarial dispatch manifest.
It includes canonical-chain reference failures, illegal proposal/Commerce
transitions, both generic and isolated Electrostatic proposal targets, non-Mass
units, Mass subject/conflict/supersession integrity, three-component Harmony,
Commerce/Harmony evidence chronology, and contract literal drift. The remaining
files prove fail-closed duplicate-key and nested schema-closure audit behavior.
The test suite also constructs valid full proposal lifecycle and two-Mass
conflict/supersession packages without populating the canonical registry.
Add Value text is governed by explicit locale script allowlists plus
NFC/trim/casefold comparison; the package makes no unbundled full-UTS39 claim.
